w3Mentions.name: Buffering
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. Buffering is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🐗 RAID — 5 raiders (The Loud Beast, The Ugly Beast, The Reunion, The Reunion, Ad Break) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! The palisade's stakes take their toll as they come over the wall.

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📼 RERUN ×1 — you have seen this episode. It has seen you too. (Overtime: +25% HP, +12% damage.)
firstContext: 📼 RERUN ×1 — you have seen this episode. It has seen you too. (Overtime: +25% HP, +12% damage.)
Aarón showed Quinn the broad paired leaves with sweet white bell flowers in spring, red berries later — "remember it." The haven hears about it by supper.
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: You hold still behind cover. After a while, the sounds fade. It lost your trail.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
📺 SYSTEM: "The System was going to take Quinn. Quinn is away from Haven. The show must go on — it takes Salvador instead."
📺 SYSTEM: "It is today. You dreamed about the cameras. Everyone did. The village is very quiet."

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (18/9/6), with 8 wave-4 fought, 15 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 2 · Forage 9 · Craft 4 · Talk 23 · Explore 34 → 24 · capped)
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TENDER — YOU TEACH MORE THAN YOU TAKE. I AM... KEEPING UP. BARELY. DO NOT SLOW DOWN ON MY ACCOUNT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; the relay carried faithfully. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ OUTSHONE — Salvador Lugo did what you would not: acted, boldly, while there was still time. The village thrives. The god is someone else. The record notes, kindly and accurately, that you watched. It stings exactly as much as it should.
